faqs.question: Is Halloweentown on Disney Plus?

faqs.question: Does Disney Plus have any R-rated Halloween movies?

faqs.question: Will these films still be on Disney Plus for Halloween 2027?
faqs.answer: There is no guarantee; every claim here is dated 13 October 2026. Disney published its October 2026 arrivals list on 16 September 2026, so look for the 2027 list in mid-September before Sunday 31 October 2027.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Halloween Movies on Disney Plus, Checked Region by Region

Halloween movies on Disney Plus, as of 13 October 2026, centre on Hocus Pocus and Hocus Pocus 2 (both rated PG by the MPA), the two Haunted Mansion films, Edward Scissorhands, Werewolf by Night and the Halloweentown series. What changes by country is the R-rated horror: in the US, Disney's own Halloween guide tags 6 of its 14 picks as Hulu titles, while Barbarian sits on Disney+ itself in Canada.

If movie night includes someone in another city, the invite matters as much as the film. 48.4% of views of shared SubhSandesh pages happen on a phone or tablet, and a shared page collects 11.1 views on average. The sections below cover 10 titles with MPA and BBFC ratings, a five-country comparison, the October 2026 additions and the cases where Disney+ is the wrong service.

## What does "on Disney+" mean where you live?

"On Disney+" means a title is in the catalogue your account's country can stream, and that catalogue is not the same in every market. In the US, Disney+ and Hulu are separate libraries: [Disney's US Halloween watch guide, revised 9 October 2026](https://www.disneyplus.com/explore/articles/best-halloween-movies), carries a footnote saying select Hulu content plays inside Disney+ and the rest only in the Hulu app.

Outside the US the line falls somewhere else. On 13 October 2026 we requested Disney+ pages from five countries: Canada opened Barbarian on Disney+ Canada, the UK opened Halloweentown High on Disney+ UK with a 6+ badge, and from India every disneyplus.com address we tried redirected to hotstar.com/in, the JioHotstar service. Our Australian request came back with the US page, so this post makes no Australia-specific claim.

## 10 Halloween movies on Disney+, checked 13 October 2026

Every entry below follows one fixed pattern: where we confirmed it, the US rating from the Motion Picture Association, the UK rating from the BBFC, and who it suits. Films made for television never went to either board, so for those we report the badge Disney+ itself shows.

### 1. Hocus Pocus (1993)

- **Confirmed:** Disney+ US title page (1h 36m), and on the recommendation rail of a Disney+ UK page.
- **MPA:** PG, with [the MPA citing scary sequences and language](https://www.filmratings.com/search-results/?search=hocus+pocus), certificate 32530.
- **BBFC:** PG, for mild scary scenes, violence and sex references.
- **Suits:** a mixed-age group that wants the familiar one; read the BBFC's sex-references note before pressing play with young children.

### 2. Hocus Pocus 2 (2022)

- **Confirmed:** listed as a Disney+ title, not a Hulu one, in Disney's US guide.
- **MPA:** PG.
- **BBFC:** no film classification turned up in our 13 October 2026 search of bbfc.co.uk, so check the badge in your app.
- **Suits:** the second half of a Sanderson double bill, which is how Disney's own guide pairs it.

### 3. Halloweentown High (2004) and the other three Halloweentown films

- **Confirmed:** Disney+ UK title page, 1h 23m; its rail links Halloweentown, Halloweentown II: Kalabar's Revenge and Return to Halloweentown on Disney+ UK.
- **MPA:** none; it was made for the Disney Channel.
- **BBFC:** none; the Disney+ UK badge reads 6+.
- **Suits:** a weekend marathon; this is the third film of four, so start with the 1998 original.

### 4. Under Wraps (1997)

- **Confirmed:** Disney+ US title page; Disney's October schedule lists it arriving on 9 October 2026. The 2021 remake and Under Wraps 2 have separate Disney+ pages.
- **MPA:** none; a made-for-TV film.
- **BBFC:** none found.
- **Suits:** children who prefer mummies to ghosts. Disney's synopsis has three friends helping a 3,000-year-old mummy find his lost love.

### 5. Something Wicked This Way Comes (1983)

- **Confirmed:** Disney+ US title page, 1h 35m.
- **MPA:** PG.
- **BBFC:** PG, classified on 29 April 1983.
- **Suits:** teenagers and adults who want slow dread over gore, as a sinister carnival rolls into Green Town.

### 6. Haunted Mansion (2023)

- **Confirmed:** Disney+ US title page, 2h 5m, and listed as Disney+ in Disney's US guide.
- **MPA:** PG-13, a step up from the PG on the 2003 Eddie Murphy version.
- **BBFC:** 12A for cinemas on 10 July 2023, for moderate horror.
- **Suits:** tweens and up with time to spare; at 2h 5m it is the longest film here.

### 7. Muppets Haunted Mansion (2021)

- **Confirmed:** Disney+ US title page, 54 minutes, badge TV-PG.
- **MPA:** none; a Disney+ special.
- **BBFC:** none.
- **Suits:** younger children and anyone with under an hour. The story is set on Halloween night itself.

### 8. Werewolf by Night (2022)

- **Confirmed:** Disney+ US title page, 54 minutes; a 2023 "in Color" version has its own page.
- **MPA:** none; a Marvel Studios special made for Disney+.
- **BBFC:** none; the European Disney+ page we were served showed 16+.
- **Suits:** older teenagers and adults who want a black-and-white monster hunt without leaving the Marvel catalogue.

### 9. Edward Scissorhands (1990)

- **Confirmed:** listed as a Disney+ title, not a Hulu one, in Disney's US guide.
- **MPA:** PG-13.
- **BBFC:** 12, for moderate violence.
- **Suits:** a couple who want something gothic and gentle rather than frightening.

### 10. Barbarian (2022)

- **Confirmed:** [Disney+ Canada title page](https://www.disneyplus.com/en-ca/browse/entity-a513bfb2-acca-4a6e-ab76-bc52c35a4807), 1h 43m. In the US, Disney's October schedule lists it under Hulu from 1 October 2026.
- **MPA:** R.
- **BBFC:** 18, for [strong bloody violence, gore and horror](https://www.bbfc.co.uk/release/barbarian-q29sbgvjdglvbjpwwc0xmda4mti4), classified 18 October 2022.
- **Suits:** adults only. In the US you need Hulu access, not Disney+ alone.

## Disney+ Halloween by country: five markets compared

This table sets out what a 13 October 2026 check could and could not confirm in each market the post covers.

| Country | Confirmed on 13 Oct 2026 | Where R-rated horror sits | Age label we saw |
|---|---|---|---|
| United States | Disney guide: 14 picks, 8 Disney+, 6 Hulu | Hulu; select titles play inside Disney+ | MPA PG, PG-13; TV-PG |
| United Kingdom | Halloweentown High page, 1h 23m | Not confirmed (request served another European storefront) | Disney+ badge 6+ |
| Canada | Barbarian page, 1h 43m | On Disney+ itself (Barbarian, R) | Not captured |
| Australia | Not confirmed (request served the US page) | Not confirmed | Not captured |
| India | disneyplus.com redirects to hotstar.com/in | JioHotstar, not checked title by title | Not captured |

The takeaway: only the US splits Halloween horror into a second service, so a US reader who wants Longlegs or The Monkey needs Hulu, while a Canadian reader may find Barbarian on Disney+ already.

## What Disney+ added for Halloween in October 2026

[Disney's "Next on Disney+ and Hulu" schedule for October 2026](https://press.disneyplus.com/news/next-on-disney-plus-october-2026), published on 16 September 2026, lists these US arrivals:

- **2 October:** Coven Academy season 1, all episodes, on Disney+ and Hulu.
- **7 October:** Vampirina: Teenage Vampire season 2, all episodes, plus Halloween episodes of Phineas and Ferb, Big City Greens and Kiff.
- **9 October:** Under Wraps (1997).
- **1 October, Hulu only:** Ghostbusters (1984), Hotel Transylvania (2012) and Barbarian, which a Disney+-only account will not show.

For Halloween 2027, which lands on Sunday 31 October 2027 after Saturday 31 October 2026, expect the equivalent list in mid-September. New arrivals still compete with the old favourites. In a 2025 study, [Siles and colleagues followed 40 streaming users through month-long diaries](https://www.cogitatiopress.com/mediaandcommunication/article/view/9338), then ran focus groups with 13 of them, and found people rewatch for what the authors call ontological comfort: stability, predictability and surprise they can plan for.

That fits the October pattern. Disney's US guide even runs a Halloween Movies playlist that plays one title after another, built around Hocus Pocus and Halloweentown.

## MPA, BBFC or the Disney+ badge: which rating to read

The two boards do not always agree in wording or age. Haunted Mansion (2023) carries an MPA PG-13 against a BBFC 12A for cinemas, Edward Scissorhands is PG-13 against a BBFC 12, and Hocus Pocus is PG on both sides while only the BBFC note mentions sex references.

The Disney+ badge is a third opinion. The European Disney+ page our UK request landed on showed Hocus Pocus at 12+, stricter than the PG both boards gave it, and Werewolf by Night, which no board rated, at 16+. For anything made for TV or for Disney+, the badge in your own app is the only label there is.

## Pairing the film with a page for someone far away

A shared Disney+ night across two cities still needs something that arrives before the film starts. Our pages are built for that one person, not for a group chat, and 38.5% of SubhSandesh creators add a password before sharing.

- The [interactive Halloween card with a pumpkin to carve](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) is roughly a five-minute build with room for six photos, and it can play This Is Halloween from its list of eight Halloween songs. Pick it for a quick, playful hello.
- The [premium Halloween page with a voice note and unlock time](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween-premium) is roughly a ten-minute build with room for 12 photos and a 60-second voice note, and it can remain locked until a moment you choose. Set the unlock for the minute the film starts; their one reply comes back to you by email.

If you would rather ask someone to the movie night itself, [the invitation page they have to answer](https://subhsandesh.in/date-invitation) turns a yes into a countdown to the evening.

## When a Disney+ Halloween night is the wrong plan

Disney+ alone is the wrong service for US viewers who want current R-rated horror: all 6 Hulu-tagged picks in Disney's guide, from Longlegs to The Monkey, need Hulu access. Readers in India should start in JioHotstar, because disneyplus.com sends them there.

Our pages have limits of their own. They cannot stream or sync a film, the interface is English only, and every page is addressed to a single person, never a watch party of ten. Catalogues also move: every availability claim here is dated 13 October 2026, and a title can leave before 31 October 2027.

## Sources

- Disney+ Press, "Next on Disney+ and Hulu: October 2026", 16 September 2026.
- Disney+ Canada, Barbarian title page, checked 13 October 2026.
- BBFC, Barbarian (2022) classification record, classified 18 October 2022.
- Motion Picture Association, Hocus Pocus rating record (certificate 32530), checked 13 October 2026.
- Siles, Muñoz-González, Valerio-Alfaro and Valiati, "Rewatching Content on Streaming Platforms: The Pursuit of Ontological Comfort", Media and Communication 13, 5 February 2025.
